sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner is directed to remove all the defects pointed out by the office within one month.
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Shikarpur P.S. Case No. 32 of 2019,
registered for the offences punishable under Sections 147, 341, 342, 353, 448, 427, 224 and 504 of the Indian Penal Code.
As per allegation, when the police party proceeded to arrest co-accused Sikandar Gaddi, who was wanted in another case, the accused persons named in the FIR misbehaved with the police personnel.
They assaulted the chawkidar and rescued the main accused Sikandar Gaddi.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.51001 of 2022(2) dt.17-01-2023
The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner was not wanted in that case, rather co-accused Sikandar Gaddi was wanted.
The petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case.

He has also submitted Sheikh Firoz @ S. K. Firoz @ Nanhak Sheikh vs The State Of Bihar on 17 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109205284/
1 that the two cases mentioned in paragraph no. 3 are of trivial natures and one of those are under Section 498A and in both the cases, the petitioner is on bail.

entities.text: Sheikh Firoz @ S. K. Firoz @ Nanhak Sheikh vs The State Of Bihar

sentences.text:
Considering the above-mentioned facts and circumstances, the petitioner above-named, in the event of his arrest or surrender, within four weeks from today, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, West Champaran at Bettiah in connection with Shikarpur P.S.
Case No. 32 of 2019, subject to condition as laid down under section 438(2) Cr. P.C. Office shall ensure that all defects are removed by the petitioner within the stipulated time mentioned hereinabove, failing which, the matter shall be brought to the notice of this Court.

(Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J)
